evidence.quote: Purchase extra usage at API pricing
Light quota to code with agents
All requests require the token in the Authorization header
The Devin MCP server is an authenticated service that provides access to both public and private repositories, plus full platform management capabilities.
URL: https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp Works with HTTP-compatible clients

result.notes: Devin's REST API and official MCP server both authenticate via bearer tokens (service-user API keys prefixed cog_, or personal access tokens); legacy apk_ keys are deprecated for MCP. API access is not included on the $0 Free plan — it requires a paid Pro ($20/mo) or higher plan, with extra usage billed at API pricing, so this is a self-serve paid tier rather than a free dev sandbox. No documented enterprise-only gate or app-review process was found; a developer can sign up and pay to get a working key today, but not for free.
result.one_liner: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer agent that writes, tests, and ships code, controllable via a REST API and an official MCP server.
